title: Crocs, Inc. reports second quarter 2026 financial results
excerpt: Crocs Brand Surpasses $1 Billion In Quarterly Revenue For The First Time
summary: The SEC-hosted Q2 2026 release reports record USD 1.179 billion revenue, 12.0% direct-to-consumer growth, 7.2% wholesale contraction, 59.4% gross margin, USD 296 million adjusted operating income and USD 4.55 adjusted diluted EPS. Crocs Brand grew 4.3% while HEYDUDE fell 5.7%. Management raised full-year revenue growth guidance to 1%-2% and adjusted diluted EPS to USD 13.70-14.00; first-half free cash flow was USD 232.0 million, total borrowings were USD 1.31 billion, and repurchase authorization was expanded.
